response: We're introducing Saved Views, a new way to organize how you and your team see your work, available today for everyone on a paid plan. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, Saved Views let you capture the exact combination of filters, grouping, and sorting you rely on most, then return to it in a single click. This update is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, so every subscriber can start using it right away. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to set up dedicated views for sprints, priorities, clients, or personal workflows. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to align on the same board layout, keep everyone looking at the same priorities, and cut down on repetitive setup work across projects. We built this based on feedback about wanting faster, more consistent ways to navigate busy projects. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
